sections.profileLine: What the counselor and the Finder know about you.
sections.interfaceLine: Language and color theme. Both apply at once.
sections.aiLine: Keys are stored in your system keychain, never in the database or as plain text. Finder needs OpenRouter. The counselor works with either provider.
sections.dataLine: Everything UniWorld has saved on this computer.
sections.aboutLine: Where the facts come from, and what UniWorld does not do.

about.paragraph: UniWorld shows real universities and real facts. Every fact carries its source and the quote it came from. When a fact cannot be found, the app says so and does not guess.
